artifacts.notes: The artifact is the complete PDF, not a passage extract. Internet Archive's automated OCR was used only to locate the title pages and locus; edition identity and passage wording were checked on the rendered page images. The item metadata's 1887 date conflicts with the volume title pages and is not used as the edition date.
artifacts.rights_basis: The underlying Latin work and 1896 scholarly printing are in the public domain in the United States by age and date of publication. The Internet Archive delivers a mechanical scan of that public-domain printing; the 28,719,132-byte PDF is identified and hashed but is not redistributed from this repository.
